actions.description: Intent kinds this target declares. An undeclared action is capability_unsupported, not attempted.

revision.description: Revision the target was observed at. An adapter MUST reject a target whose revision differs from the surface's current revision before invoking the host (error target_invalidated).

role.description: Profile-defined: link, textbox, file (browser); thread, frame, scope, variable (dap).

surface.description: Opaque, server-minted. Never parsed by clients.

target_id.description: Opaque, server-minted. Never parsed by clients.
